title: Trapped Inside A Crazy Metal World #shorts
description: An old man drags a skeptical friend through a dangerous maze of wires and glowing mechanical vines.
attribution_block: Source: "Elephants Dream" by Unknown (2006), CC BY (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/us/). Original: https://archive.org/download/ElephantsDream/ed_1024_512kb.mp4. Narration, selection, editing, and commentary created for this channel. Narration generated with text-to-speech.

beats.narration: Walking into a giant metal maze with a crazy old guy is a terrible idea.
beats.visual_cue: Prue with a white coat leads Emo through a dark network of cables.

beats.narration: Prue guides Emo right through a complex industrial environment filled with hanging wires and cold metal structures.
beats.visual_cue: Prue leading Emo across metallic bridges and hanging wires.

beats.narration: Big mistake trusting a guy who just walks on thin wire pathways over a massive drop.
beats.visual_cue: The characters traverse a vast mechanical lattice of pipes.

beats.narration: Prue explains the strange mechanical world to a very skeptical Emo as they march across the pipes.
beats.visual_cue: Prue talking to Emo while walking across intricate wire pathways.

beats.narration: Instead of listening, Emo stops to stare at dangerous machinery everywhere.
beats.visual_cue: Prue and Emo stand on a raised platform surrounded by complex machinery.

beats.narration: Prue points out various mechanical hazards while Emo expresses total distrust in the crazy environment.
beats.visual_cue: Prue pointing to hazards while Emo looks distrustful.

beats.narration: Pure madness to keep walking when the whole place is obviously a trap.
beats.visual_cue: Close up on Emo showing distrust on the platform.

beats.narration: Moments later, Emo aggressively argues with Prue inside a metallic corridor.
beats.visual_cue: Emo confronts Prue inside a metallic corridor with valves on the walls.

beats.narration: Emo claims the whole environment is a giant trap and refuses to trust the machine.
beats.visual_cue: Emo gesturing angrily at Prue near metal pipes.

beats.narration: Stubbornness is going to get them both completely stuck in here forever.
beats.visual_cue: Prue listening calmly to Emo inside the corridor.

beats.narration: That's when Prue ignores the argument and leads Emo straight into a glowing core chamber.
beats.visual_cue: Prue and Emo stepping into a large glowing cavernous space.

beats.narration: Massive mechanical vines and organic tendrils instantly surround them from every single direction.
beats.visual_cue: Glowing golden and orange mechanical cables twisting around the characters.

beats.narration: Worst outcome possible—walking right into the heart of the monster machine.
beats.visual_cue: Massive tendrils closing in around Prue and Emo.

beats.narration: They are trapped together as the golden metallic vines lock down the entire cavern.
beats.visual_cue: Prue and Emo trapped inside the giant glowing organic mechanical cables.
